title: Replication package for: Where Does the Accuracy of LLM-Based Root-Cause Analysis Come From? An Empirical Study on Microservice Benchmarks
description: Protocol, amendments, execution logs, code, prompt hashes, raw model responses, per-case rankings and analysis outputs of a pre-registered study of where an LLM-based root-cause analysis agent's accuracy comes from, on RCAEval RE2 and RE3. A history-free snapshot of the pre-registration record https://github.com/saadhussain07/rca-benchmark-study, whose tags carry the timing of the protocol and of each amendment.
